formulas.K1_0: K1_0/sqrt(pi*L) = R(r), r=(1-nu_u)/(1-nu); R(r)=r*a_beta, beta=2*(1-r), where a_beta is the inner/outer square-root opening ratio of the mixed Fourier operator defined in ANSWER.md. Numerical estimate only; not an evaluated closed formula.
formulas.p_faces_0: p_faces_0 = 2*(nu_u-nu)/(alpha*(1-2*nu)) in the undrained outer limit; exactly on the face p=0

K1_0_status: Provisional numerical extrapolation, estimated uncertainty 0.01; exact tip matching remains unresolved.
